_source: Johnsoncab Electricals Limited (BSE SME). The RHP and DRHP sit on www.bsesme.com / api.bseindia.com, which this environment cannot reach, and SME offer documents are not posted on SEBI. Figures are restated standalone financials to 31-Mar-2026 as reproduced from the offer document by public IPO trackers (IPO Platform, IPO Central, HDFC Sky, Chittorgarh, unp.me, read 28-Oct-2026), cross-checked against each other. Where trackers give only total income (FY24, FY25), it is used as revenue. Items marked 'estimate' are analyst estimates derived from reported totals (see rationale), not reported figures. No page cites are possible until the RHP is read.

1.finding: NAV Rs 40.47 on net worth Rs 31.44 cr implies about 77.7 lakh pre-issue shares; EPS Rs 17.81 on PAT Rs 13.42 cr implies a weighted 75.4 lakh, consistent with a small FY26 share issue (net worth rose Rs 17.20 cr against PAT Rs 13.42 cr).

2.finding: Operating cash flow not available without the RHP. Borrowings rose from Rs 41.79 cr to Rs 79.88 cr in FY26 while total assets nearly doubled (Rs 64.28 cr to Rs 126.64 cr), so growth was largely funded by debt and working capital absorbed most of the profit.

7.finding: Goodwill and intangibles not available; none reported by trackers.

rationale.g1: Revenue Rs 88.95 / 140.00 / 210.47 cr FY24-26 (+57%, +50%). The issue funds a new shed and plant (Rs 17.79 cr), paper-insulated conductor machinery (Rs 6.89 cr) and Rs 14 cr of working capital, so capacity rises from FY27-28. Neutral 20% then 16% / 13% / 11% / 9% (well below the last two years, as working capital, not demand, is the constraint); Bear 6-12%; Bull 30% fading to 11%. Utilisation is not known without the RHP.
rationale.m: EBITDA margin 6.14% / 8.68% / 11.43% FY24-26 (EBITDA Rs 5.42 / 12.14 / 24.06 cr). FY26 is the first year at this level and is high for low-voltage cables, where copper is pass-through and margins are usually 8-12%. Neutral 10.5%; Bear 8.5% (FY25 level); Bull 12%.
rationale.nwc: Estimate: not reported by trackers. Total assets Rs 126.64 cr less estimated fixed assets (~Rs 15 cr) and cash (~Rs 1 cr) less non-debt liabilities (Rs 15.32 cr = total assets - net worth - borrowings) gives about Rs 95 cr (45% of revenue); FY25 about Rs 43 cr (31%). The FY26 sources and uses reconcile on this basis (PAT 13.4 + D&A 1.2 + new debt 38.1 + new equity 3.8 = working capital build 52 + capex 4). FY26 is likely inflated by year-end government receivables; Neutral 40% (between FY25 and FY26); Bear 47%; Bull 35%.
rationale.roic: ROCE 39.68% and ROE 42.68% in FY26 on a thin equity base; terminal ROIC 18% (Neutral) after the issue adds equity and capacity.
rationale.capex: D&A Rs 1.2 cr and base capex Rs 4.2 cr are estimates (EBITDA 24.06 + other income 0.87 - PBT ~17.9 implied by PAT at 25% tax leaves ~Rs 7 cr for interest and D&A; interest on ~Rs 61 cr average debt at 9.5% is ~Rs 5.8 cr). Net debt taken as gross borrowings Rs 79.88 cr (cash not disclosed by trackers, so none is credited). IPO capex Rs 27.91 cr (shed, plant, conductor machinery, rooftop solar). Fresh issue 28,00,800 shares = Rs 56.02 cr at Rs 200.
rationale.relative: Relative value uses peer-median P/E only (w_pb set to 0, an issuer-specific override). Peer P/B of 3.2x-9.8x reflects 20-47% ROEs on thin SME books; applying 5.5x to Johnsoncab's post-issue book, about 60% of which is fresh issue cash, would value cash at 5.5 times its face. Peers' EBITDA is not available, so EV/EBITDA is not used either.
